headline: Ukraine's fiber-optic drone supply squeezed by AI data center demand
summary: Ukraine's fiber-optic drone production is being squeezed as AI data centers compete with Russia and Ukraine for China's optical fiber supply. A Ukrainian drone manufacturer says limited fiber optic supplies are making it harder to build jam-proof fiber optic drones.

claims.statement: Ukraine's fiber-optic drone operations are being squeezed by a fiber optic cable shortage triggered by AI data center demand for China's optical fiber supply.

sources.quote: Ukraine’s fiber-optic drones get squeezed by AI data center demand
Ukraine competes with Russia and data centers for China’s optical fiber supply.

claims.statement: A Ukrainian drone manufacturer, BlueBird Tech, says limited fiber optic supplies are making it harder to build jam-proof fiber optic drones.
